description: Recurring bearded caveman with yellow tunic with black spots; thick black outline; flat fills; many poses (standing grumpy; thinking; talking; laughing arms up; running). Redrawn per pose; tunic template reused.
Two cavemen at start: A arms up grinning; B holding rock. Same drawings in white and dirt scenes (reused identically).
Brown-tunic caveman: wave grin; sniff rock; tiny lying dead pose; name tag appears.
White tag with handwritten "gruG" on brown tunic.
Tiny caveman lying on back with X eyes; brown tunic version G0016 and yellow tunic version G0126; same pose redrawn with colour swap.
Photographic brown soil with mound; skull and worm; only photo-real element besides painted sunset.
Painterly orange-purple sunset with hills; caveman in profile in front.
Bright green rock with radiating lines held in hand; close-up face reused with slight redraw.
Angry grey rock with purple wizard hat with star; reused at different scales (large; speck; small; left).
Two yelling rocks facing each other with sound lines; reused identically at G0150 after first use; red X added later.
Thick red hand-painted X over rocks.
Elderly man with glasses in wheelchair with tablet; line drawing; two renditions with different hatching.
Yellow-orange cartoon mushroom cloud; reused identical drawing at several scales; also base-only crop with lines.
Line-drawn erupting volcano with red lava.
Red lava pool with heat lines and stern feathered caveman lifting screaming small caveman.
Yellow hard hat; hammer; tool belt.
Caveman with exposed brain holding stone tablet.
Grey metal cylinder with shine lines; reused identically in later diagram.
Nine gold coins with caveman faces.
Round white face with oval eyes and smile; later sleeping expression with zZ.
Curved black arrow linking items left to right; used in rock to ball to tube chain.
Black handwritten zZ above sleeping face.
Bearded scientist in lab coat with glasses holding red button; cable; second version with purple star hat.
Fist gripping box with red button; background for quoted text.
Bold black uppercase handwritten text built word-by-word: CLICKY / CLICKY / FIRE / NOW with quotation marks.
Two large hands cupping a rock; angry face with shake lines then calm face.
Long-haired caveman arms crossed: yellow tunic version then colourless version with belt; yelling with steam puff.
Bearded yellow-tunic caveman with palms out sliding in; later hands raised alarmed.
Pale bomb with yellow radiation symbol; shown once then ten in grid.
Solid black frame holding moon.
Blue crescent moon with grinning face on black.
Yellow sun with grin on white.
Close-up long-haired bearded face: crying shocked then with black sunglasses and smirk (redrawn).
Skeleton with black sunglasses replaces caveman beside cloud.
Tiny caveman centred on white; scale joke.
Caveman running left with flame at right and speed lines.
Bald frowning version then hair-and-beard version coughing; coughing drawing reused at smaller scale.
Large caveman with raised index finger.
Four tribe members (two men; woman; child) with thumbs down.
Ten radiation bombs in 2x5 grid.
Green-tunic runner with radiation ball; ball pile; laughing chief on throne with feather headdress.
Yellow caveman and green-feather caveman conversing: two pose pairs.
Caveman laughing arms raised; two slightly different poses.
Large grumpy standing caveman facing left.
Long spear: single head then double head.
Caveman in mortarboard pointing at chalkboard reading LESSON.
White uppercase text "LESSON" on black board.
Small campfire with logs; reused with caveman roasting burger.
Caveman holding burger on stick over fire.
Earth globe in black and grey with orange flames; fades out to white at end.
Visual system: thick black outlines; flat yellow; plus green; orange; blue; purple accents on white; occasional black frame.
